hero.eyebrow: A LITTLE CORNER OF THE INTERNET
hero.title: Welcome to my little corner of the internet.
hero.description: I'm a creative developer exploring software, design, and interactive experiences. This is where I share the things I've been making, the ideas I'm exploring, and a little world of my own.

about.title: Behind the screen.
about.intro: Developer by craft, creative by nature.
paragraphs: I'm a developer who enjoys bringing ideas to life through code, thoughtful design, and a little bit of experimentation.
I like exploring how software can be useful, expressive, and enjoyable to interact with. Empty Spaces is my little home for sharing that journey.

contact.title: Have something in mind?
contact.description: Whether it's a project, an idea, or just a friendly hello, I'd love to hear from you.

footer.message: Made with care in Empty Spaces.
